description: Backtest NoiseFloor's own one-step forecast on chronological historical prefixes, issuing before observing and then updating without hindsight. Use to evaluate forecast_next's coverage and misses; this tool does not accept externally supplied predictions. At least 20 readings are required; shorter valid histories return ok=false. Successful results contain n_forecasts, empirical_coverage, nominal_coverage, score, baseline_score, beats_baseline, records, misses and worst_misses. Scores are mean weighted interval scores in input units (lower is better), compared with fixed historical-error quantiles. Records use zero-based input indices and retain actual, forecast, interval and missed_by. within_coverage_tolerance and its calibrated alias mean observed coverage is within 0.05 of target; they are descriptive, not a certification or significance test. Coverage and favorable scores do not establish future market performance or profitability.

nominal.description: Target interval coverage fraction, default 0.80. Use the same value passed to forecast_next for like-for-like replay; not a confidence level for the backtest result.

values.description: One to 2048 chronological realized observations with consistent units/cadence; at least 20 to score. Predictions begin after ten one-step errors, so the first scored record has zero-based index 11.
